title: AgentOrchestratorReviewVerdict
description: Structured review output from the review worker under Review Convergence Protocol. Exact PASS is the only merge-authorizing control verdict and may carry deferred non-blocking notes. PASS_WITH_NOTES remains schema-valid for recording only and does not authorize merge. ci_green is a reviewer-observed boolean only; authoritative CI comes from the trusted exact-head CI owner, never from a model-authored field.

verdict.description: PASS: no open blockers; only authorizing control verdict (deferred notes allowed). PASS_WITH_NOTES: schema-valid non-authorizing record only. BLOCKED: one or more open blockers. FAIL: critical defects or task non-satisfaction. DECISION_REQUIRED: stop for human adjudication; no autonomous third round.

reviewed_head_sha.description: The exact PR head SHA that was reviewed

review_mode.description: full = R1 complete base...head review; repair_verification = R2 complete attestation with delta-first focus on prior blockers

review_round.description: Substantive independent-review round (R1 or R2); never exceeds 2 without explicit human authority

reviewed_base.description: The exact base SHA of the reviewed range

reviewed_range.description: The complete reviewed range as base...head

prior_reviewed_head.description: The head reviewed in the prior round (R2 continuity)

blockers.description: Legacy open hard-contract blocking strings. Must be empty for PASS/PASS_WITH_NOTES; must be non-empty for BLOCKED. New artifacts should use structured findings with disposition=block_current_head.

major_notes.description: Deferred non-blocking major notes; allowed on PASS; must not force a new head

minor_notes.description: Deferred non-blocking minor notes; allowed on PASS; must not force a new head

findings.description: Structured findings ledger. Each finding separates severity (impact) from disposition (current-head effect).

origin_head.description: The exact head that introduced this finding

admission_reason.description: Required on R2 (repair_verification) for NEW open block_current_head findings

open_blocker_ids.description: Finding ids with disposition=block_current_head and status=open; must exactly match the findings array

deferred_note_ids.description: Finding ids deferred as non-blocking notes; must exactly match the findings array

decision_required_ids.description: Finding ids with disposition=decision_required and status=open; must exactly match the findings array

finding_ledger_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the id-ordered finding ledger; recomputed and verified by the validator

ci_green.description: OBSERVATION ONLY: whether required CI looked green to the reviewer at review time. Never authorizes; authoritative CI is read independently from trusted GitHub state by the merge owner.

security_ok.description: Whether the diff passes security review

rollback_ok.description: Whether the change has a clear rollback path

unavailable_reason.description: Required when verdict=DECISION_REQUIRED originates from unreviewable state: explicit, bounded, non-sensitive reason
